against_jpl_horizons.note: Horizons uses the same JPL orbit solution, so this verifies the evaluation and the apparent pipeline, not the orbit.

against_installed_swisseph_0_5_17.reading: The difference is smallest (0.3 arcsec) where Chiron was observed most recently (2000-2030) and grows toward the ends of 1900-2100 (1.3 and 1.7 arcsec): the reference orbit fit is older. It is a difference of orbit solutions, not of the apparent-position pipeline.
